There's a difference between waiting and being ready. Most people can manage the first one, sit still and let days pass without forcing anything.

The second part is harder. It means staying alert enough that when the setup actually shows up, you still recognize it and still have the energy left to act on it.

A lot of missed opportunities didn't come from impatience. They came from patience that quietly turned into looking without actually seeing anything.

tweets.text:
The end and start of the month and quarter are usually choppy and love sweeping liquidity (on both sides).

Not the place where you want to position yourself directionally straight away usually.

Usually best to let it play out some days and then reassess.

quote.text:
$BTC The last and first week of the calendar month have been awful places to trade directionally. The past 4 months have only seen bad market environments in those weeks.

Pretty much all the action has come from the third week of the month. This usually comes after weak price action into that week only for it to reverse from there.

Of course the sample size is small but the main thing you should take away from this is that most action happens in a short timeframe. The market has been moving like this for years now.

Miss the few big moves and you need to be very patient again for the next one, both up and down.

Most of what this market has become is sideways for weeks or even months only for the actual action to occur in a short few day/week timeframe.

That’s how much was transferred to attacker-controlled addresses in last week’s CEX security breach.

So I started looking a bit closer at the security features available to me.

One that stood out was OKX Shield, currently available for @OKX customers in Europe.

I like that it’s not just about what happens after something goes wrong. I can actually see my security status and strengthen my account with things like passkeys, device checks and withdrawal controls.

And once Shield is active, there’s also added account protection of up to €100,000 for regular customers, and up to €500,000 for VIP customers.

No separate subscription either.

I activated mine. If you’re an eligible Europe verified customer on OKX, I’d check what your Shield status looks like too: https://my.okx.com/join/44376323

tweets.text:
Let's discuss luck a little bit. I consider myself, extremely lucky but luck is something you can create, and generate. 

There's several kinds of luck. There is luck from pure chance, where you did nothing to cause it. You were truly in the right place at the right time. This is the only one you can't control.

There is luck from motion, which come from opportunities you create by doing things. investing, trading, starting a business, meeting people, building things. Most of the time, it goes nowhere but you expose yourself to a larger surface area of luck which means more chances for something unexpected in a good way to happen. 

Luck from awareness. An opportunity presents itself for thousands of people to see. But you are one of the people capable of seeing it. This comes from years of experience that train you to see things most people overlook. This imo happens constantly in investing where the information and opportunity are public and you're able to recognize the significance of it. So the luck isnt finding the information instead its simply recognizing it. 

Then the last is luck unique to you. you have developed relationships, skills, or a unique brand. Someone like threadguy comes to mind here. You became the type of person or a person that lucky events can happen to.

So you have the ability to create 2-4, 1 is just by chance. But there is a saying that luck is the residue of hardwork. So essentially, lucky people just expose themselves to it more.  The people who succeed at the end of the day are the people who take chances. It doesnt mean they are guaranteed to succeed bc most people wont. but you certainly increase the odds of it
